name_match:warn:close: Even small differences — a missing middle name, an extra initial — are enough for this check to fail automatically.
name_match:fail:moderate: When the names differ this much, the system can't safely assume it's the same person, so it blocks the claim.
name_match:fail:severe: This isn't a typo-level difference — the records need to be corrected before this claim can go further.
date_of_exit:warn:self_declare_eligible: Your employer usually confirms this, but after 60 days of silence you're allowed to confirm it yourself.
date_of_exit:fail:waiting_period: Without this date, the system can't tell if you've actually left your job yet — that's what blocks a final settlement.
bank_account:fail:name_mismatch: Banks reject transfers when the account name doesn't match the claimant's name — this catches that before the bank does.
bank_account:fail:inactive: An inactive or unverifiable account means there's nowhere for the money to actually go yet.
